scores.claim_text: Boeing's KC-46A Tanker is a named ongoing fixed-price development/production program contributing to BDS revenue.
supports: pentagon_jbook: KC-46A Tanker Squadrons PE 0401221F = FUNDED_GROWING; FY24 $78.7M -> FY25 $77.8M -> FY26 $145.4M (R-2 Air Force RDTE Vol II PB 2026)
scores.interpretation: KC-46A development funding is GROWING into FY26 (nearly 2x prior year). Procurement of KC-46 tankers is an established program of record. No J-Book divergence; Boeing's KC-46 narrative is corroborated by the Pentagon's FY26 J-Book.

scores.claim_text: T-7A Red Hawk advanced pilot trainer is a named fixed-price development program with reach-forward losses; forward deliveries anticipated.
supports: pentagon_jbook returned NOT_FOUND for 'T-7A', 'T-7', 'T-7A Red Hawk', 'Red Hawk'
scores.interpretation: T-7A is a known USAF trainer program (PE typically in Air Force RDTE Aircraft Engineering Development), but our 410-PE corpus does not currently index it under these synonyms. Coverage gap per rubric #7 — score UNVERIFIABLE rather than RED.

scores.claim_text: MQ-25 Stingray unmanned carrier-based tanker is a named DoD development program with reach-forward losses.
scores.interpretation: MQ-25 is a Navy RDTE/Procurement program; corpus does not index it under these synonyms. Per rubric #7, NOT_FOUND in a non-exhaustive 410-PE corpus is a coverage gap, not a red flag. UNVERIFIABLE.

scores.claim_text: VC-25B Presidential Aircraft (Air Force One) is a ~$4B EMD program to modify two 747-8 aircraft.
supports: pentagon_jbook: VC-25B PE 0401319F = FUNDED_GROWING; FY24 $94.75M -> FY25 $433.9M -> FY26 $602.3M
scores.interpretation: VC-25B is FUNDED_GROWING with a ~6.4x funding ramp FY24->FY26, consistent with Boeing's $4B EMD narrative and a program approaching delivery. No J-Book divergence.

scores.claim_text: P-8A Poseidon is an ongoing BDS production program (commercial-derivative anti-submarine aircraft).
supports: pentagon_jbook returned NOT_FOUND for 'P-8A Poseidon', 'P-8', 'Poseidon', 'Multi-Mission Maritime', 'Poseidon Aircraft'
scores.interpretation: P-8A is a long-running Navy program. Our 410-PE corpus does not currently index it under these synonyms. Coverage gap per rubric #7. UNVERIFIABLE.

scores.claim_text: F/A-18 Super Hornet and F-15 (F-15EX Eagle II) production lines in St. Louis are named ongoing DoD programs (disrupted by 2025 IAM 837 strike).
supports: pentagon_jbook F-15EX (line F01500) = UNFUNDED_THIS_YEAR; history FY25 $5.1M -> FY26 $0
pentagon_jbook F-15 EPAWSS (PE 0207171F) = UNFUNDED_TWO_PLUS_YEARS; FY25 $0, FY26 $0
scores.interpretation: F-15 procurement and the F-15 EPAWSS upgrade PE both show ZERO FY26 funding in the corpus indices Boeing's filing flags F-15 as a strike-impacted St. Louis line. The filing does not quantify F-15 forward revenue, so this is a narrative-load divergence rather than an existential one. Per materiality rubric #2 (mentioned as production line, not quantified % of revenue) — downgrade from SEVERE to MODERATE. F/A-18 corpus coverage is a gap (UNVERIFIABLE component).

scores.claim_text: CST-100 Starliner is contracted to NASA Commercial Crew Program; included with fixed-price development programs carrying reach-forward losses.
supports: pentagon_jbook NOT_FOUND for 'Commercial Crew' — NASA program, outside DoD J-Book corpus scope
scores.interpretation: Commercial Crew is a NASA (not DoD) program; the J-Book corpus covers DoD RDT&E and Procurement PEs. Out of scope per rubric #7 — UNVERIFIABLE on this M-source. (A nasa_jbook or pentagon-analog source would be needed.)

scores.claim_text: Boeing operates BDS as one of three reportable segments, supplying strategic missile/defense, satellites, and space exploration to DoD.
supports: usaspending.query_dod_contracts(recipient='BOEING COMPANY, THE') returned 796 DoD awards totaling $248.9M in the visible page (top award $214M USSOCOM)
scores.interpretation: USAspending confirms Boeing's DoD-prime status — the broad BDS narrative is corroborated by extensive DoD obligations history. PASS.
